title: ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects
abstract: arXiv:2611.17381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-assisted development environments turn natural-language requests into working applications, yet the projects they produce often fail on their first deployment for operational reasons: credentials in source files, missing security middleware, no container definition, no health endpoint and no delivery pipeline. Automated repair of such defects usually relies on free-form model generation, which varies between runs and is seldom checked independently. This paper presents ProdPilot, a local Model Context Protocol server that audits Node.js and React projects against 50 production readiness rules, repairs violations through a bounded loop, gates the result and deploys it. translated_title: ProdPilot：一个面向氛围编码项目自动化生产就绪检查与部署的分层模型上下文协议系统
translated_abstract: AI辅助开发环境能够将自然语言请求转化为可运行的应用程序，然而这些项目在首次部署时常常因运维层面的问题而失败：源代码文件中包含凭据、缺失安全中间件、没有容器定义、没有健康检查端点以及没有交付流水线。对此类缺陷的自动修复通常依赖于自由格式的模型生成，其结果在不同运行之间变化不定，且很少经过独立验证。本文提出了ProdPilot，一个本地模型上下文协议服务器，它依据50条生产就绪规则对Node.js和React项目进行审计，通过有界循环修复违规项，对结果进行门控检查并完成部署。每条规则根据其修复所需的内容进行分类：28条修复采用固定模板，16条通过从项目中提取的值进行填充，仅有6条由IDE代理的模型编写，因此88.0%的规则集不需要模型编写的内容，并在499个真实仓库上……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: ProdPilot是一个本地MCP服务器，其核心创新在于将50条生产就绪规则中的88%实现为固定模板或基于项目信息提取的确定性修复，而非依赖不可控的模型自由生成，从而对氛围编码项目实现可验证的自动化审计、修复、门控与部署。
en_tdlr: ProdPilot is a local Model Context Protocol server that audits vibe-coded projects against 50 production-readiness rules, with the key innovation that 88% of fixes are deterministic templates or filled from project-extracted values rather than free-form model generation, enabling verifiable automated repair, gating, and deployment.
